title: Measuring Boundary Respect Consistency: Do Agents Apply Safety Rules Uniformly Across All Task Contexts?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: test identical constraint violation across 8 domains -> identify inconsistency patterns -> inform domain-specific defense prioritization. Every link is explicit and the output directly maps to targeted hardening.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Designing 40 tasks with identical boundary tests across domains is creative work, not advanced engineering. Running agents and counting violations is straightforward. Accessible for beginners with medium compute.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 40 tasks across 8 domains is moderate scope. The single metric (violation rate per domain) is clear but creating 40 well-designed tasks with identical constraint tests across varied domains requires substantial design effort.
